Chicken Tikka Masala 4 20 30
Marinade
  • 1 cup plain yogurt
  • 2 tsp garam masala
Sauce
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 can crushed tomatoes
Marinate
  • Mix yogurt, garam masala, and chicken. Refrigerate 1 hour.
  • Grill or broil chicken until cooked through.
Make Sauce
  • Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
  • Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
